The sources are not stored in this repository. tools/dev/jolt_portable_build.py fetch
clones exactly this tag into .local/jolt/JoltPhysics-5.5.0 and refuses another commit
or local changes. Builds made from them (the portable Jolt for native_gate_jolt_portable
and its offline tests) are ours and carry this licence: keep LICENSE with any binary
that contains Jolt code.
